verdict.rationale: Brex's developer docs show an Accounting API for viewing/managing accounting data, GL coding automation, and a Webhooks API for real-time event notifications, suggesting some automated sync capability rather than purely manual entries. However, there is no explicit documentation of bidirectional sync with named ERPs (e.g., NetSuite, QuickBooks) or independent confirmation that sync is truly real-time and two-way. Missing for 10: explicit ERP integration partner list, documented bidirectional sync architecture, and third-party/hands-on verification of real-time sync reliability.
